output.decision: Add the shaker cup to the third shipment as a one-time, non-consumable retention gift. It aligns with creatine use without increasing the amount of supplement received, which is relevant to the observed “too much product” cancellation reason. Include a reminder that emphasizes flexibility and gives customers an easy way to skip or adjust before the order processes. Proposed reminder: “Your third creatine shipment is coming soon—and we’re including a complimentary shaker cup. Have more creatine than you need? You can skip, delay, or adjust your delivery before it processes.”
next_steps: Confirm the shaker cup is useful, durable, and economical after packaging and shipping costs.
Set eligibility rules: third paid shipment only, one per subscriber, while inventory lasts.
Add a pre-billing reminder with a clear skip, delay, and frequency-adjustment link.
Test the message against a no-gift control or alternative non-consumable gift.
Track cancellation, skip, adjustment, and repeat-order rates for eligible customers.
missing_inputs: Shaker cup unit cost, inventory, dimensions, and incremental shipping impact.
Current shipment cadence and the lead time available for reminders or changes.
Whether customers commonly already own shaker cups or have requested other accessories.
Baseline third-shipment cancellation and retention rates, segmented by cancellation reason.
assumptions: General ecommerce judgment is used because no library evidence was supplied.
The shaker cup is compatible with the brand’s creatine product and can be included without material fulfillment issues.
The subscription platform supports skip, delay, or frequency changes before processing.
